summary: Organize and maintain knowledge collections with audience-led navigation, stable source and claim identities, authority and effective states, bounded reads, versioned derived views, and recoverable retirement.
triggers: design or reorganize a knowledge base taxonomy, navigation, and stable record identities
maintain knowledge collection source lineage, canonical records, conflicts, and effective versions
repair knowledge-base aliases, links, incremental indexes, and stale derived views
retire, redirect, deduplicate, or recover knowledge records while preserving rights and access distinctions
maintain handbook and documentation rename aliases, citation locations, maps and dependent caches
antiTriggers: ordinary file lookup or answer from an already supplied document
standalone note edit with no collection architecture or lifecycle change
build or tune a question-answering retrieval and generation pipeline
acquire private transcript exports or persist session memory without source and write authorization

Original collection specialist adds navigation/taxonomy, path-independent identity, source/claim/view lineage, independent conflict/canonical/effective/approval states, access-sensitive duplicates, coherent incremental generations and recovery. Mnemosyne retains broad continuity and lifecycle routes; retrieval-grounded answering retains QA pipeline ownership. Maturity denotes authored instructions; independent review, behavior evaluation, storage implementation and parent acceptance remain pending. Fresh writing does not itself resolve source-rights uncertainty.
